summary: Cheaper lenses: vortex ring nearest point by a 3-step curvature iteration instead of the 32-step bisection (3.3x, max 0.32 px off; VORTEX_RING_LENS_NEAREST_ITERS 0 restores it), black hole per-well influence early-out (~1.8x, exact), and an opt-in march-free Soliton wall bend (_MW_STANDIN, on only outside a tube and by default only on phones; 3-14x, approximate)
why: Offline cost study of the game's shaders (Unity stand-ins thread); Soliton's march was the costliest pass after the HyperSea sky
